_README: SEED source for `pnpm sync-registry`. `items` = standalone apps/publications (their canonical row). `curate` = INITIAL per-id overrides (featured/teaching/topic/type/status/title/…) applied when sync first inserts a row; afterwards the Turso `gallery` table is authoritative and editing it (not this file) is how you curate. The app reads the unified registry from Turso (live) / content/registry.snapshot.json (committed fallback) — see lib/registry.ts.

items.title: The Measure of Words
items.description: A field booklet on text as data — six data essays, two live studios, and a data shelf, from dictionary word counts to LLM measurement at scale.

items.title: The Well-Being Atlas
items.description: A publication of reproducible data essays on life satisfaction — Gallup World Poll, GSS, and WVS microdata across 50 years and 168 countries.

items.title: World Trade Atlas
items.description: A bilateral goods-trade explorer — 226 countries × 5,021 products, 1995–2024 (CEPII BACI), with country profiles, comparisons, and stories.

items.title: Health of America’s ZIP Codes
items.description: A map-first atlas of 26 health and social-need measures across 32,409 ZIP/ZCTAs (CDC PLACES + Census), with stories and methodology.

items.title: AI Models & Benchmarks
items.description: A filterable, sortable comparison of frontier and open-weight models — context windows, pricing, modalities, and access.

items.title: Research Data Gallery — SCRC & Dewey
items.description: A research-data gallery surfacing curated datasets for teaching and analysis.

items.title: Insight Digest
items.description: AI-generated book summaries to read or listen to — across philosophy, psychology, self-help, history, and geopolitics.

items.title: LLM Prediction Arena
items.description: Can AI beat the crowd? Six LLMs make blind probability forecasts on live prediction markets — scored on calibration and skill against the market price, then pooled into an ensemble.

items.title: FAL Campaign Studio — AI Marketing Case Studies
items.description: Teaching case studies and FAL-powered tools for generative AI in creative marketing — study real campaigns, then turn a strategic brief into production-ready image assets.

items.title: The American Political Almanac · 1976–2024
items.description: An interactive atlas of U.S. presidential elections, 1976–2024 — national, state, and county returns, demographics, and ANES survey shifts.

items.title: Chat FRED
items.description: Chat with the Federal Reserve Economic Data API. Explore economic indicators, time series, and datasets through natural conversation—powered by cached data for instant responses.

items.title: College Ledger — Every U.S. College, on the Record
items.description: Cost by family income, graduate earnings and debt, and three decades of trajectory for 6,273 accredited U.S. colleges — College Scorecard + IPEDS, shown honestly: suppressed is suppressed, never zero.

items.title: Worldlines — The World in Numbers
items.description: A cross-country indicators explorer — 85 measures of development, democracy, belief, and wellbeing across 217 countries (1750–2025), with country profiles, rankings, and peer benchmarking.
